commands.name: linux-daemon-dependency-hashes
command:
import hashlib,json,pathlib,sys
lock=json.loads(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())['daemon']['linux']
prefix=pathlib.Path(lock['prefix'])
for item in lock['files']:
 actual=hashlib.sha256((prefix/item['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 if actual != item['sha256']: raise SystemExit('Daemon dependency drift: '+item['path'])
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','checked_files':len(lock['files'])}))

acceptance_results.scope: Exact results, no write replay, USB-to-P1 parser fragments with fake IO.
Per-handle progress/isolation; group validity/routing is P3/P4.
5 independent pinned-header/zlib goldens; original SPI sources unchanged; intentional bounded error semantics.
macOS portable/native USB link and Linux full USB/SPI transport link, ASan/UBSan. Not full active pandad build or target-device ABI.

Fixed canonical synthetic slots and full P0 typed profile; independent Python P0 check for eight profile/inventory permutations on each platform.
All six bidirectional routes, flags and capability rejection; wire checked against independent Python formula. Fake P2 transfers only.
Connection epochs and group generation prevent stale partial data, queues and callback reuse; existing bindings never change implicitly.
Frozen fake-clock age/queue budgets, per-board FIFO, Event.valid equivalent rejection, overflow counters and final held-object age checks. No live scheduler or synchronized hardware timestamps.
Structural complete-group availability only. Missing/invalid required board means zero routed simulated TX; live permissions remain false. P4 health/safety/message barriers not implemented.
Actual frozen-schema serialization of exactly2 slots; all required health/CAN-health fresh; original observation age retained. Native messages also read by actual Python consumer policy.
Exactly2 explicit noOutput configs with per-slot params, shared CarParams alternativeExperience, ordered writes and independent readbacks; simulated gating only.

Selected actual consumer functions/branches execute against serialized fixtures; default single-board behavior preserved. Actual native event cycle uses injected ingress/publication, without launching full Python daemons.
No implicit ELM327/OBD/query/realCAN; Python wrapper and native compatibility guards reject ordinary hardware startup under profile.

Role-specific fan, power and harness; OR of configured ignition sources; unsupported IR/diagnostics/power-save output never invented. Peripheral wire power fields come from the explicit power-monitor role, including separate fan/power owners; missing required values make the Event invalid.

Bounded fake-clock host exit, noOutput write/readback then heartbeat(false), fresh offroad reconfiguration and disabled-enabled edge. Actual pinned firmware C with HAL stubs proves distinct heartbeat/SILENT and watchdog-fault behavior; no MCU hardware claim. Fresh offroad transition immediately retires queued control and engaged heartbeat; onroad is required before a new enable.
Required fan observation/deviceState loss closes simulated control; healthy peer exits, no unknown physical fan fallback or hardware-cooling claim.
Actual pinned safety/firmware C with HAL mocks on F4/H7 host policies; local buses and negative checksum/counter/freshness. F4 capability handshake before group writes.
